Whole account about 13% a year against 14% for the S&P 500. Best trade +146%, worst -25%.
Caution: the test list is today’s well-known companies, which flatters the past. The paper record below, counted from now on, is the honest test.
FAIR TEST (whole market, collapsed stocks included, 2021-11-01 to 2026-11-06): this version PROVISIONALLY PROMISING. It passed in the newer half at the 0.8% cost. Live paper trades must still confirm it.
Paper record since this list started: 8 finished, 13% won, average -13.1% a trade after costs. Winners averaged +0.6%, losers -15.1%. Profit factor 0.01 (above 1 means it earns). Best +0.6%, worst -38.3%. Deepest fall of the paper account 21.0%. Under 20 finished trades: too few to judge. If every entry had been filled at the dearest price inside its buy range: average -16.1% a trade.
Costs in these figures: 0.8% a trade (3 USD + 3 USD fees on a 1,000 USD buy plus the spread), the same cost the fair test uses. Trades finished before 18 Oct 2026 were counted at 0.4%.
